newsitem.title: THAILAND: Texaco signs Thai oil exploration deal.
newsitem.headline: Texaco signs Thai oil exploration deal.

text.p: Thailand said on Monday it signed an agreement awarding petroleum exploration and production rights to Texaco Exploration (Thailand) II Ltd, a unit of U.S.-based Texaco Inc.
Texaco Exploration would spend over 300 million baht ($12 million) in the first three years of exploration in the Gulf of Thailand, an industry ministry official told Reuters.
The awarded concession area, coded B 11/38, covered 8,690 square kms and was about 100 kms offshore from the southern province of Nakhon Si Thammarat, the official said.
Texaco was one of five oil firms to win the concessions for petroleum exploration and production in the 15th round of bidding called in February this year.

The other four companies were SOCO Exploration (Thailand), Cairn Energy (Thailand), a unit of U.K.-based Cairn Energy Amerada Hess Exploration (Thailand), a unit of U.S. Amerada Hess Corp and Anschutz Overseas Corporation, the official said.
SOCO Exploration (Thailand), a unit of Snyder Oil Corp, signed a similar contract last week. The rest were expected to sign in November, she added.
